items.title: Start with the top three rows
items.detail:
The numbers: 0 applications recorded in the last 7 and 14 days. 19 open rows, 12 closing within 30 days, 9 of them on October 16, now 12 days out.

A likely reason nothing has gone out: nineteen rows with nine marked urgent gives no obvious place to begin. So tonight the page picks three, tagged *First three* in Open now, in this order:

**1. Kite Data Management** (El Segundo, closes October 16). Kite and Gilead run on the same Workday system, so the profile you build here should carry to the Gilead rows.

**2. Stryker Statistical Programming** (Irvine). Names a master's and accepts R. No close date, so it can come down without notice.

**3. Analysis Group Health Care** (Los Angeles, October 28). Names first-year master's students in biostatistics. It needs a cover letter and transcripts, so start the letter now.

Everything below those three can wait until they are in. If something has already gone out, say so: a tick on this page stays in your browser, and the count here only moves once it is recorded.

**3. Email Michigan Public Health's employer engagement coordinator** (see Contacts) for the employers that came to the fall fair and an alum at Gilead, Kite, Amgen or Edwards.

New tonight: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan posted a Data Science / Biostatistician intern in Detroit. It is outside your metros, so it sits last in Open now. Say so if a Michigan summer is off the table and it comes off.

items.title: How this field hires a master's student
items.detail: Big pharma opens structured summer programs between September and November and often prefers or requires a PhD for biostatistics seats; read the qualification line before the title. Gilead lists PhD as *preferred* on most of its reqs, which is a ranking signal; master's students can still apply. Contract research organizations hire master's statisticians at volume, but later and more rolling, and mostly in SAS. Southern California device companies run their own calendars: Stryker and Edwards' clinical track are open now, and Edwards' remaining tracks open February to April. Smaller biotechs post later still: Corcept's master's-level biostatistics intern for last summer came down on January 6. Economic and HEOR consulting states master's eligibility openly and pays the most.

items.title: Analysis Group: Summer Analyst, Health Care
items.location: Los Angeles (also SF, Boston, New York)
items.detail: Names *first year masters/MPH candidates* in biostatistics or epidemiology. Claims, EHR and trial data in R, SAS and Stata; cost-effectiveness and budget-impact models. $2,000 a week, 3.3 GPA floor, evaluated for a full-time offer in your internship office.
